purpose: Machine-readable catalog of every chart type the BI Dashboard can render and every curated dashboard template. Use this to let an AI assistant propose a dashboard from a plain-English description while only ever emitting real chart types and valid widget configs.

chart_type.id: string — matches the `chartType` string DynamicChart.tsx switches on
chart_type.label: string — human display name
chart_type.category: comparison | trend | distribution | composition | relationship | kpi
chart_type.best_for: string — one line of when-to-use guidance for the AI
chart_type.requires: { measures: [min,max], dimensions: [min,max] } — value-column and category/axis-column count bounds
chart_type.compatible_aggregations: string[] — aggregators that make sense for this chart's measures

dashboard_template.label: string — display name
dashboard_template.widgets: Array<{ chart_type, title, position }> — position is { x, y, w, h } in a 24-col grid

rules: A chart_type id MUST exist as a `chartType ===` branch in DynamicChart.tsx — no invented types.
validateChartConfig() rejects a config whose measure/dimension counts fall outside `requires`.
`table` widgets are not chart types; templates may still list them but the AI proposes chart_types only.

categories.comparison: Compare a measure across discrete categories
categories.trend: Show how a measure evolves over an ordered (usually time) axis
categories.distribution: Show the spread or shape of a single measure
categories.relationship: Show correlation between two or more measures
categories.kpi: Surface a single headline number or progress against a target

chart_types.label: Bar Chart
chart_types.description: Vertical bars comparing a measure across categories.
chart_types.best_for: Comparing one measure across a handful of discrete categories.

chart_types.label: Line Chart
chart_types.description: Connected points tracking a measure across an ordered axis.
chart_types.best_for: Showing how one or more measures change over time.

chart_types.label: Pie Chart
chart_types.description: Circular slices showing each category's share of a total.
chart_types.best_for: Showing parts of a whole with a small number of categories.

chart_types.label: Donut Chart
chart_types.description: Pie chart with a hollow centre, often used for a headline total.
chart_types.best_for: Parts of a whole when you also want a centred KPI label.

chart_types.label: Area Chart
chart_types.description: Line chart with the area beneath filled, emphasising volume.
chart_types.best_for: Trend over time where cumulative magnitude matters.

chart_types.label: Scatter Plot
chart_types.description: Points plotted on two measure axes to reveal correlation.
chart_types.best_for: Examining the relationship between two numeric measures.

chart_types.label: Heatmap
chart_types.description: Colour-encoded grid showing intensity of a measure by category.
chart_types.best_for: Density or concentration of a measure across categories or regions.

chart_types.label: Funnel Chart
chart_types.description: Stacked descending stages showing drop-off through a process.
chart_types.best_for: Conversion or stage drop-off across an ordered pipeline.

chart_types.label: Gauge
chart_types.description: Radial dial showing a single value against a range.
chart_types.best_for: A single measure shown as progress within a min/max range.

chart_types.label: Treemap
chart_types.description: Nested rectangles sized by a measure to show hierarchy and share.
chart_types.best_for: Parts of a whole with many categories or a hierarchy.

chart_types.label: Radar Chart
chart_types.description: Polygon plotting multiple measures on shared radial axes.
chart_types.best_for: Comparing several measures for one or a few categories.

chart_types.label: Waterfall Chart
chart_types.description: Floating bars showing cumulative effect of sequential changes.
chart_types.best_for: How an initial value is increased and decreased to a final total.

chart_types.label: Stacked Bar Chart
chart_types.description: Bars segmented by a series to show composition within each category.
chart_types.best_for: Composition of a total across categories with a series breakdown.

chart_types.label: Stacked Area Chart
chart_types.description: Area chart with series stacked to show cumulative trend composition.
chart_types.best_for: Composition trend over time across multiple series.

chart_types.label: Histogram
chart_types.description: Bars showing how often a measure's values fall into bins.
chart_types.best_for: The frequency distribution of a single numeric measure.

chart_types.label: Combo Chart
chart_types.description: Bars and a line on shared axes to mix magnitude and trend.
chart_types.best_for: Showing a count/total as bars alongside a rate/trend line.

chart_types.label: Candlestick Chart
chart_types.description: OHLC candles showing open/high/low/close across an axis.
chart_types.best_for: Open-high-low-close style ranges over an ordered axis.

chart_types.label: Bubble Chart
chart_types.description: Scatter plot where a third measure controls bubble size.
chart_types.best_for: Relationship between two measures with a third encoded as size.

chart_types.label: Radial Bar Chart
chart_types.description: Bars wrapped around a circular axis, one ring per category.
chart_types.best_for: Comparing a measure across categories in a compact circular layout.
